name: Pricing
description: Mortar marketing pricing, using central semantic tokens.

props.title: string
props.plans: { id: string; name: string; description: string; monthly: string; annual?: string; unit?: string; annualUnit?: string; features: string[]; action: LinkAction; featured?: boolean; availability?: "available" | "coming-soon" | "unavailable"; availabilityLabel?: string }[]
props.id: string (the root element's id, e.g. an in-page link target)
props.className: string (layout only: margins or grid placement)
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 2); plan names sit one level below
props.extra: { name: string; description: string; price?: string; unit?: string; action: LinkAction } (a full-width tier band under the plans, e.g. enterprise or a discount; four plans lay out 4, 2 then 1 across)

contract.usage: Import { Pricing } from @tony-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states. The root element exposes data-m-component for tests and consumers. It is not a styling hook. Annual prices show only while the billing toggle is visible. Unavailable plans show static status text and no purchase link.
